description: Source code for handling Git object files, including packing, unpacking, reading, writing, and managing loose objects and packfiles within Git's object database.

classes.name: odb_loose_read_stream
classes.description: Stream structure for reading loose objects with zlib decompression.

classes.name: odb_read_stream
classes.description: Abstract base for object data streams.

classes.name: odb_source
classes.description: Represents a source of loose objects in the object database.

classes.name: odb_source_loose
classes.description: Specific source type for loose objects, including cache management.

classes.name: odb_transaction
classes.description: Represents a transaction for batch object file operations.

classes.name: transaction_packfile
classes.description: Represents a packfile being written during a transaction.

methods.name: fill_loose_path
methods.description: Constructs the loose object path based on object ID and hash algorithm.

methods.name: check_and_freshen_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and optionally updates its timestamp.

methods.name: check_and_freshen_source
methods.description: Checks and optionally updates the timestamp of a loose object in a source.

methods.name: odb_loose_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path for a loose object.

methods.name: format_object_header
methods.description: Formats the object header string with type and size.

methods.name: check_object_signature
methods.description: Verifies the object file matches its expected hash.

methods.name: stream_object_signature
methods.description: Computes the hash of an object stream and compares with expected.

methods.name: stat_loose_object
methods.description: Checks if a loose object exists and retrieves its stat info.

methods.name: open_loose_object
methods.description: Opens a loose object file and returns its file descriptor.

methods.name: quick_has_loose
methods.description: Checks if a loose object is in the cache.

methods.name: map_fd
methods.description: Memory maps a file descriptor.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_map_object
methods.description: Maps a loose object into memory.

methods.name: unpack_loose_header
methods.description: Initializes zlib stream to unpack a loose object header.

methods.name: unpack_loose_rest
methods.description: Unpacks the remaining data of a loose object.

methods.name: parse_loose_header
methods.description: Parses the header of a loose object to extract type and size.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_info
methods.description: Reads metadata about a loose object, including type and size.

methods.name: hash_object_body
methods.description: Calculates the hash of an object body with header.

methods.name: write_object_file_prepare
methods.description: Prepares header and hash for writing an object file.

methods.name: check_collision
methods.description: Checks if two files have identical contents.

methods.name: finalize_object_file
methods.description: Moves temporary object file to final location.

methods.name: finalize_object_file_flags
methods.description: Moves and permissions a temporary object file with collision check.

methods.name: hash_object_file
methods.description: Computes the hash of an object file.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_begin
methods.description: Begins a new object database transaction.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, flushing loose objects and packfiles.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_new
methods.description: Creates a new loose object source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_free
methods.description: Frees a loose object source and its cache.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_reprepare
methods.description: Reprepares (clears cache) for a loose object source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_cache
methods.description: Returns cache of loose objects for a source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_stream
methods.description: Creates a stream to read a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_has_object
methods.description: Checks if a loose object exists in source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_freshen_object
methods.description: Updates timestamp of a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_object
methods.description: Writes a new loose object to the database.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_stream
methods.description: Streams data to write a loose object.

methods.name: force_object_loose
methods.description: Forces a loose object to be written and updated.

methods.name: read_loose_object
methods.description: Reads and verifies a loose object from disk.
